get.description: Retrieves podcast episodes from Darknet Diaries Podcast.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

audioLengthBytes.description: Audio file size in bytes when provided.

contentHtml.description: Full encoded episode content HTML when present.

descriptionHtml.description: Episode description HTML from the RSS item description.

duration.description: Episode duration as published in the feed.

episodeTitle.description: Episode title without the prefixed number when available.

explicit.description: Whether the episode is marked explicit.

link.description: Public Darknet Diaries episode page URL.

publishedAt.description: Episode publish timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

summary.description: Plain-text or lightly formatted episode summary.

title.description: Full episode title from the RSS feed.

transcriptType.description: Transcript MIME type when the feed provides one.

transcriptUrl.description: Transcript URL when the feed provides one.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
